click Anyone with the link card

click What’s new, help, contact, more…
click the To Do List row
inline database appears in page body
expand More settings, then click Connections
expand More settings, then click Customize page layout
click the three-dot “Data source actions” beside Todo List
opens Layout panel with Open pages in chooser expanded
hover above row title, then click "Customize layout"
open a row, then choose Open in full page from Side Peek or use breadcrumb/full-page route
click the dropdown arrow beside New
click setup guide step “Browse quick guides and templates”
click Search and type a query
click the up/down-arrow icon at the right of filters
click Agents heading, then its "Open menu" overflow
click the Page name column header
right-click a page row such as Getting Started
Open “Set up your workspace”, then click “Give Notion AI some personality”.
click sidebar `Home`; fallback navigate to https://app.notion.com/home
click `Getting Started` in Recently visited or sidebar
